abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: The Inverter
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 53.0/54.7/56.5/58.3/60.3/62.3/64.4/66.7/69.0/71.4/73.8/76.4/79.1/81.9/84.7/87.7/90.7/93.8 (+70% physical power) physical damage. Pulsefire modifies GRIM.exe's basic attacks to deal Magical Damage.

abilities.name: Pulsefire
abilities.description: GRIM.exe's basic attacks are modified to deal Magical Damage. GRIM.exe's basic attacks and abilities apply Pulsefire to Enemies hit for 4s. The next basic attack or ability will burst the Pulsefire and deal 15 (+15% physical power)(+30% magical power) true damage on-hit.

abilities.name: Displacement Blast
abilities.description: Fire an empowered shot forward that deals 30.0/75.0/120.0/165.0/210.0 (+105% physical power)(+100% magical power) magical damage. In Assault Mode, the shot is Lobbed and displaces Enemies away from the center of the explosion.

abilities.name: Assault Mode
abilities.description: Sentry Mode: Basic Attacks restore 8 mana and grant 6.0/8.5/11.0/13.5/16.0% attack speed for 3s, stacking up to 4 times. Stacks fall off individually. Assault Mode: Basic Attacks cost 30 mana, increase to 1650 Range and deal (+10% physical power)(+8% magical power) bonus magical damage on-hit, cleaving for 20.0/40.0/60.0/80.0/100.0% damage. This damage can critically strike.

abilities.name: Energy Shield
abilities.description: GRIM.exe activates a shield for 1.5s that blocks the next incoming enemy ability. If the shield successfully blocks an enemy ability, GRIM.exe restores 15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0% of his missing mana.

abilities.name: GTFO
abilities.description: GRIM.exe slows himself by 60% and locks onto an enemy hero. After a short channel, a Gyro Targeted Force Orb is launched. The Orb will pass through the world and non-hero units, but can be blocked by enemy heroes. The Orb deals 300.0/520.0/740.0 (+135% physical power)(+110% magical power) magical damage.

augments.name: System Restore
augments.description: Blocking an Ability with Energy Shield restores 20 (+10% max health) Health and grants 20% Decaying Movement Speed over 2s.

augments.name: Reboot.exe
augments.description: Triggering Pulsefire reduces your Current Basic Ability Cooldowns by 10%, increased to 25% against Heroes.

augments.name: Instant Reload
augments.description: GTFO now Executes Heroes that fall below 5% Max Health. When this occurs, GTFO may be re-cast for 8s.
